{{Quote|My duty is to support the Hand, which means supporting you. Whatever your opinion is, I defer to it.|Darth Rivix to the Commander|<ref name="The Task at Hand" />}}
'''Darth Rivix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in [[Third Galactic War|the renewed conflict]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He first gained recognition during his dedicated service in the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]]. In [[3626 BBY]], following the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|battle]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Vowrawn]] appointed him as the liaison of the [[Hand of the Empire]], a position coveted by many powerful Sith.

==Background==
[[File:DarthRivix.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Rivix]]
Little was known for certain about Darth Rivix's origins, or any part of his personal history before he joined the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]], and all inquiries into the matter seem to be met with dead ends. Even those who had directly asked Rivix to confirm details about his past had come away with more questions than answers. The perception of his interests and opinions seemed to shift depending on who was speaking about him.<ref name="Codex" />

Those who worked with Rivix in the Diplomatic Service remembered him as dedicated, charming, and as someone whose performance consistently stood out. Naturally, it came as no surprise to anyone when he was selected to lead the newly-formed [[Hand of the Empire]].<ref name="Codex" />

Although other powerful Sith had competed for the position, naming Rivix as the Hand's liaison to the [[Eternal Alliance]] pleased many among the Empire's ranks, as Rivix's organizational and networking skills were considered second-to-none--despite his notorious secrecy.<ref name="Codex" />

==Personality and traits==
Darth Rivix was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had medium-length [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], red skin and orange [[eye]]s. He wore black and red [[Robe/Legends|robes]] with shoulder [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and armored [[Glove/Legends|gloves]].<ref name="The Task at Hand" />

Darth Rivix possessed a very charming personality and was able to easily sway many of those he spoke to into liking him, even if they were not sure why. His opinions and interests appeared to change depending on who talked to him.<ref name="Codex" /> After meeting him, [[Vector Hyllus]] suspected that there was something different and unnatural about his ability to charm others.<ref name="Diplomatic Relations">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|Diplomatic Relations|[[Odessen]]}}</ref> Darth Rivix was also an especially secretive individual, with nothing being known about his past prior to joining the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]]. Those who questioned his background often ended up with more questions than answers. Additionally, Rivix was known to have exceptional organizational and networking skills.<ref name="Codex" />

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Rivix was adept in using the Force and skilled enough combatant to match Jedi like [[Tau Idair]] in lightsaber combat or subdue strong [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors like [[Ri'kan Kateen]]. He could use the Dark Side Force abilities like [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. His biggest strength however, was his trickery and manipulation, as he was able to fool [[Sovu|Lord Sovu]] into baiting an ancient trap and also betray the Alliance Commander's trust in favor of Darth Jadus, as he knew he could not match their skills and power in direct combat scenario.<ref name="masters enigma" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Imperial story===
In the Imperial storyline, Darth Rivix arrived on [[Odessen]] with a small task force and made first contact with the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and told them that he wished to speak with them in person. Rivix's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] landed in the hangar where the Commander received him. Rivix informed the Commander that he was there to assist the Commander in their missions and he would report their achievements back to either [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina|Acina]] or [[Darth Vowrawn|Emperor Vowrawn]] depending on the player’s previous choices, while the Empress or Emperor's orders would be given to the Commander. He requested a tour of the base before the pair discussed their business in the operations room.<ref name="The Task at Hand" />

After settling in, Rivix accompanied the Commander and [[Darth Krovos]] when they traveled to the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] to investigate the whereabouts of Darth Malgus. Darth Rivix reported their findings to the Sith Empress or Emperor after returning from their mission.<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>

After the [[Invasion of Manaan]], Rivix will accompany the Commander and [[Lana Beniko]] to the ruins of the [[Temple of Nul]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] and participate in the defeat and arrest of Malgus.<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>

Rivix later explored a ruin connected to [[Darth Nul]] with Lord [[Sovu]] and tricked him into triggering the ruin's deadly trap, after which he executed him. Before he could retrieve the lightsaber piece at the center of the ruin, he was confronted by [[Tau Idair]]. Depending on which faction the player is aligned with, Rivix either escapes with the artifact or allows Idair to have it.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds}}</ref>

===Gameplay choices===
The player has the option to flirt with him regardless of their gender. Depending on if the player is an Imperial loyalist or saboteur and rejoined the Empire or kept the Alliance independent after the battle on Corellia, then Rivix will have varying conversations between the individual characters:
*If the player is a '''Sith Warrior''' and rejoined the Empire, Rivix will address them as '''Lord Wrath'''. He will present an idea to the player on whether to increase the training of the Hand's troops or to coordinate training along with Alliance troops. A saboteur Warrior can tell Rivix the Hand's troops don't require any additional training.<ref name="The Task at Hand" />
*If the player is a '''Sith Inquisitor''' and rejoined the Empire, Rivix will address the player by their Sith title that they were granted by [[Darth Marr]] at the end of their respective Chapter 3 as '''Darth Nox/Imperius/Occlus'''. He will report that, according to their deal with either Empress Acina or Emperor Vowrawn, their past holdings as a [[Dark Council]] member will be returned to them, which included the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron|Pyron's]] [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer fleet]]. Though he will inform the player that Darth Krovos was using the fleet on the frontlines, he asks if they wish for the fleet to remain where they are or to be returned at once to Odessen. A saboteur Inquisitor can express dissatisfaction with the Silencer fleet's performance and tell Rivix to keep them in maintenance indefinitely.<ref name="The Task at Hand" />
*If the player is an '''Imperial Agent''' and rejoined the Empire, Rivix will address them as '''Keeper'''. He will inform the player that [[Darth Xarion]] was surprisingly agreeable to the player being granted command over covert operations and some of the new members were secretly Xarion's personal spies. Rivix will ask whether they should be kept on surveillance or killed. A saboteur Agent can suggest reporting Xarion to Acina/Vowrawn.<ref name="The Task at Hand" />
*If the player is a '''Bounty Hunter''' and rejoined the Empire, Rivix will address the player as '''Hunter'''. He will later inquire whom to prioritize the Hand's additional bounty hunters against: Republic personnel, senators and military officials or Imperial traitors and failed Sith. A saboteur Hunter can tell Rivix to dismiss the other bounty hunters and let Alliance personnel deal with the targets.<ref name="The Task at Hand" />
*If player character kept the Alliance independent, Rivix will address the player character as "Commander".<ref name="The Task at Hand" />
